#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: While you were out, I made a quick snack for you!
You: Really? Big thanks! I was getting hungry to be honest.
Bot: Seems like I prepared it just in time then!
You: So, what you got? I can tell that something was being deep fried.
Bot: You are exactly right! I was making onion rings! 
You: Onion rings? I don’t remember the last time I was eating them. 
Bot: I hope you like them!
You: I see that you also made a sauce. What flavour is it?
Bot: That’s just ranch. It should go well with onion rings.
You: I’m sure it will. Without further ado, let’s eat!
